answer: The clock-tower winding drum admits one bonded hand per shift, never a stack of borrowed keys. The keeper stakes 31.5 POA, must reach the east landing before civil dawn, then turn the ferrous barrel through a painted 40-tooth arc while a banked ember under the oil cup keeps the grease thin. A clerk drawn by lot times the tooth count against the official dawn punch, photographs the barrel serial beside the glowing cup, and requires a signed plate of that pair within 17 seconds. A keeper still on a second stair, a cold cup, or a missed plate forfeits 8.1 POA and yields the drum.
